files.description: Main dashboard and input form interface.

files.content: body { font-family: sans-serif; padding: 20px; } #dashboard { margin-bottom: 20px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc; }

const storage = { get: (k) => localStorage.getItem(k), set: (k, v) => localStorage.setItem(k, v) }; const getToday = () => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]; function updateDashboard() { const data = JSON.parse(storage.get(getToday()) || '{"steps": 0, "waterIntakeMl": 0}'); document.getElementById('display-steps').textContent = data.steps; document.getElementById('display-water').textContent = data.waterIntakeMl; } document.getElementById('health-form').addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const steps = parseInt(document.getElementById('steps').value); const water = parseInt(document.getElementById('water').value); const err = document.getElementById('error-msg'); if (isNaN(steps) || steps < 0 || isNaN(water) || water < 0) { err.textContent = 'Please enter positive integers.'; return; } err.textContent = ''; storage.set(getToday(), JSON.stringify({ steps, waterIntakeMl: water })); updateDashboard(); }); updateDashboard();
files.description: Logic for storage management and form handling.
Unit tests using a mock storage implementation to avoid browser dependency issues.

setup_instructions: Open index.html in any modern web browser. To run tests, execute 'python3 test_health_tracker.py'.
implementation_notes: Used a simple dictionary-based mock in Python for testing to resolve the 'js' module import error.
LocalStorage is used directly in the browser environment as per design.
Input validation is handled via standard HTML5 number inputs and JS logic.
Design decision: Frontend = HTML/CSS/JS (Simplest stack for a browser-based dashboard without backend requirements.).
Design decision: Database = LocalStorage (Provides persistent storage for a single-user local instance without needing a server or database infrastructure.).
Design decision: Using browser client-side storage (LocalStorage) for data persistence.
